oe_yk_rd_dh = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { character:oe_yk_deokheung ?= { is_alive = yes } } add = 1000 }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:KOR c:KOR = { any_character = { has_variable = oe_yk_deokheung } } } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { any_character = { has_variable = oe_yk_deokheung } } } add = 10 }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:KOR c:KOR = { any_rebel = { any_character_supporting_rebel = { has_variable = oe_yk_deokheung } } } } add = 100 }
}
